$comment: Registry adapters (v1.1). sabin (Phase 13, ADR-028): the Sabin Center Climate Litigation Database on www.climatecasechart.com. The adapter reads only server-rendered /document/<slug> and /geographies/<slug> pages (never /_search, never the app's private API). countrySlugs maps the Wikidata P17 country label to the site's geography slug; the US page is always read as well. maxCases bounds the case pages read per run (seed index entries first, then geography listings whose title names the brand).

sabin.$partyLegalSuffixes: Legal forms common in case titles but absent from config/wikidata.json legalSuffixes (which the v1 adapters' search queries also use): stripped from the end of a party name before the ADR-019 comparison. SE = Societas Europaea ('TotalEnergies SE').
